_readme: This is the one file to edit for wording, links, sizes and switches. Keep the quotes and commas as they are. showDates must stay false until Andy says otherwise. podLink: once the show is on Apple Podcasts, paste the link here and every Listen button switches to it. home.sectionOrder: drag-free reordering, just move the names. sections.videos.enabled: true turns the video section on. comingSoon.pitch and comingSoon.ctaLabel are the landing page's one ask (the big Substack button; ctaHref blank = the Substack subscribe page); comingSoon.note is the small line; comingSoon.aboutText is what the About button shows when hovered (blank hides the button). home.odometer / home.timeTravel switch the phase 3 interactions on and off.

comingSoon.aboutText:
If a tree falls in the forest but no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound? If a man bicycles across continents and doesn’t microblog about it, did it even happen?

More coming soon…
